title: Sertraline
authors: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
journal: LiverTox: Clinical and Research Information on Drug-Induced Liver Injury. Bethesda (MD): National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases; 2012-, entry updated 8 April 2020
funder: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (publisher of LiverTox).
result: Read as the PubMed abstract of the entry; the Bookshelf page returned a browser check. Sertraline therapy can be associated with transient asymptomatic elevations in serum aminotransferase levels and has been linked to rare instances of clinically apparent acute liver injury.
